# M19: -gc=MODE selection. logos defaults to greentea (wasm on GOARCH=wasm);
# plain go keeps the upstream collector unless -gc names a mode and reads no
# logos.toml. The flag beats logos.toml [build] gc. batch and epsilon compile
# every package but the runtime closure with -wb=false. Unknown modes and the
# unfinished moving modes fail with the pinned text.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# logos defaults to greentea and keeps write barriers.
logos build -n -a -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=greentea'
! stderr ' -wb=false'

# go with no flag keeps the upstream collector: no mode, no -wb=false.
go build -n -a -o $WORK/x.exe .
! stderr 'logosGCMode'
! stderr ' -wb=false'

# go -gc selects any mode.
go build -n -a -gc=batch -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=batch'
stderr '/compile .* -p fmt .* -wb=false'
stderr '/compile .* -p main .* -wb=false'
! stderr '/compile .* -p runtime .* -wb=false'
! stderr '/compile .* -p internal/abi .* -wb=false'

go build -n -a -gc=epsilon -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=epsilon'
stderr '/compile .* -p fmt .* -wb=false'
! stderr '/compile .* -p runtime .* -wb=false'

go build -n -a -gc=wasm -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=wasm'
! stderr ' -wb=false'

# -gc works under run and test, and through GOFLAGS.
go run -n -gc=epsilon .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=epsilon'
go test -n -gc=batch .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=batch'
env GOFLAGS=-gc=batch
go build -n -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=batch'
env GOFLAGS=

# logos.toml [build] gc is read under logos only; the flag overrides it.
cd batchtoml
logos build -n -a -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=batch'
stderr '/compile .* -p main .* -wb=false'
logos build -n -a -gc=greentea -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=greentea'
! stderr ' -wb=false'
go build -n -a -o $WORK/x.exe .
! stderr 'logosGCMode'
cd ..

# GOARCH=wasm defaults to wasm under logos.
env GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm
logos build -n -a -o $WORK/x.wasm .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=wasm'
env GOOS= GOARCH=

# Unknown modes fail with the command prefix, from the flag and from the key.
! logos build -gc=x .
stderr '^logos build: unknown -gc mode "x" \(want greentea, zgc, immix, wasm, batch, epsilon\)$'
! go build -gc=x .
stderr '^go build: unknown -gc mode "x" \(want greentea, zgc, immix, wasm, batch, epsilon\)$'
! go build -gc= .
stderr '^go build: unknown -gc mode "" \(want greentea, zgc, immix, wasm, batch, epsilon\)$'
! go build -gc=Batch .
stderr 'unknown -gc mode "Batch"'
cd badtoml
! logos build .
stderr '^logos build: unknown -gc mode "x" \(want greentea, zgc, immix, wasm, batch, epsilon\)$'
cd ..

# immix and zgc stay unavailable until their phases pass.
! logos build -gc=immix .
stderr '^logos build: -gc=immix requires GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving phase 1, which is not complete$'
! go build -gc=zgc .
stderr '^go build: -gc=zgc requires GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving phase 2, which is not complete$'

# The flag has help text under logos only.
logos help build
stdout '\t-gc mode\n'
go help build
! stdout '\t-gc mode\n'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/gcmode

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("gc") }

-- main_test.go --
package main

import "testing"

func TestMain1(t *testing.T) {}

-- batchtoml/go.mod --
module example.com/batchtoml

go 1.27

-- batchtoml/logos.toml --
[build]
gc = "batch"

-- batchtoml/main.go --
package main

func main() {}

-- badtoml/go.mod --
module example.com/badtoml

go 1.27

-- badtoml/logos.toml --
[build]
gc = "x"

-- badtoml/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
